title: 第17章 徒儿对师尊的孝心变质了第18章 天级灵兵屠龙刀
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 沿着一条山路，没过多久，苏长歌就又来到了叶清瑶门前。
算算次数，这已经是第三次来了，今天可真够频繁的。
摇摇头，他将心中的杂念驱赶，便敲敲门，道：“师尊，你在吗？”
“在，门没关，进来吧。”
里面传出叶清瑶柔柔的声音。
苏长歌其实也猜到门应该没反锁，不过面对美女师尊，自己肯定要保持谦谦君子的形象的。
不再多想。
他推开门，踏步而入。
叶清瑶已经不在品茶了，正在水池边，拿着一些鱼饵撒入水里。
水中有几条金鱼欢快的扑腾着，抢食鱼饵。
“徒儿，怎么了？”
叶清瑶转过身，晶莹的美眸疑惑的看着他。
她有点不明白，自己的徒儿今天怎么了，怎么来的这么频繁？
算了算，已经三次了。
是怎么了嘛?
苏长歌淡淡笑了笑，道：“师尊，之前忘记说了，藏经阁的徐老送给我一柄玄级灵兵，十分锋利，我想把它送给您。”
说着，他就将匕首取出来，递到叶清瑶面前。
叶清瑶拍了拍洁白的额头，恍然大悟。
第三次……
第三次来送自己东西。
他这样如果不是来真的，恐怕都没人相信吧？
怪不得他今天来的这么频繁，原来是在暗示自己。
“徒儿，这灵兵你可以当做防身之用，为什么要送我……”
叶清瑶觉得自己应该确定一下，于是柔柔的话语从口中传出。
苏长歌就没想那么多，不假思索的笑道：“没有那么多为什么，就是觉得师尊你很漂亮，所以想送你礼物！”
叶清瑶心中呢喃：“送我礼物……”
她柳眉一舒，心底荡起涟漪。
“徒儿三番五次送我礼物，而且还夸我漂亮，肯定是喜欢我，所以，他此举应该是在暗示我吧？”
“毕竟哪有拿着自己的东西随随便便就送人？”
“而且宗门中那么多人呢，他谁都不送，偏偏只送我……”
“这一定是……”
诸多念头从她脑海闪过，俏脸逐渐转变，一寸一寸的变红，粉晕溢满脸颊，如羞涩的花儿绽放。
心跳也逐渐加快，内心紧张，呼吸急促。
而这边，苏长歌看她脸色渐渐红了，顿时有些不明就里。
师尊的脸为什么突然红了？
难道是遇到了什么害羞的事？
“咦，莫非是因为自己！”
他突然反应过来。
自己今天三番五次过来，又送这、又送那，只要是宝物，统统都送，是不是让师尊误解了什么？
天哪，自己的孝心变质了！
content_en:
Along a mountain road, not long after, Su Changge came to Ye Qingyao's door again.
Counting the times, this is already the third time. It’s been quite frequent today.
Shaking his head to drive away the distracting thoughts in his mind, he knocked on the door and said, "Master, are you there?"
"Here, the door is open, come in."
Ye Qingyao's soft voice came from inside.
Su Changge actually guessed that the door was probably unlocked, but facing the beautiful master, he must maintain the image of a modest gentleman.
Think no more.
He opened the door and stepped in.
Ye Qingyao is no longer sipping tea, but is at the pool, holding some bait and throwing it into the water.
There were several goldfish flapping happily in the water, grabbing the bait.
"Disciple, what's wrong?"
Ye Qingyao turned around and looked at him with doubtful eyes.
She was a little confused. What happened to her disciple today? Why did he come so often?
After all, it’s been three times.
What's going on?
Su Changge smiled lightly and said: "Master, I forgot to mention it before. Mr. Xu from the Sutra Pavilion gave me a Xuan-level spiritual weapon. It is very sharp. I want to give it to you."
With that said, he took out the dagger and handed it to Ye Qingyao.
Ye Qingyao patted her white forehead and suddenly realized.
The third time...
This is my third time to give something to myself.
If he didn't mean it, no one would believe it, right?
No wonder he came so frequently today, it turned out to be a hint to himself.
"Disciple, you can use this spiritual weapon for self-defense, why did you give it to me..."
Ye Qingyao felt that she should be sure, so Rourou's words came out of her mouth.
Su Changge didn't think much about it, and smiled without thinking: "There's not much reason, I just think you are beautiful, Master, so I want to give you a gift!"
"Gift..."
Ye Qingyao murmured in her heart: "Send me a gift..."
Her eyebrows relaxed, and her heart rippled.
"My disciple has given me gifts over and over again, and also complimented me on my beauty. He must like me, so his move should be a hint to me, right?"
"After all, how can you take your own things and give them away casually?"
"And there are so many people in the sect, but he doesn't give gifts to anyone, but only to me..."
"This must be..."
Many thoughts flashed through her mind, and her pretty face gradually changed, turning red inch by inch, with a pink blush filling her cheeks, blooming like a shy flower.
The heartbeat also gradually accelerated, I was nervous, and my breathing was rapid.
But here, Su Changge saw her face gradually turning red, and suddenly became confused.
Why did Master's face suddenly turn red?
Could it be that something embarrassing happened?
"Hey, could it be because of myself!"
He suddenly reacted.
I have come here again and again today, giving away this and that, as long as it is a treasure, I have given away everything. Did Master misunderstand something?
Oh my God, my filial piety has deteriorated!
title_en: Chapter 17 The disciple’s filial piety towards his master has deteriorated Chapter 18 The Heavenly Spiritual Weapon Dragon-Slaying Knife
